note: V7.3 plan. skip_ranks = V7 slate ke kaunse rank nahi khelne (1 = MAIN). Stake = Rs per jodi. haruf type bahar = aakhri ank, andar = pehla ank. 'overrides' = tay tarikhon ke liye alag plan (tool aur bot dono aaj ki tarikh dekh kar chunte hain); baaki dino ke liye 'markets'. copy_amounts=false: copy/Telegram message mein sirf numbers (rupaye nahi). count = kitne rank khelne (default 8; Desawar 10 = rank 9-10 bhi). calendar = din/mahine/cool-down ke stake multipliers. date_rule = aaj ki tarikh wala number (aur uska palti) plan ke numbers se hata do.

overrides.label: NOVEMBER HIGH-STAKE PLAN (1-30 Nov)
overrides.rules: Backup Rs3 lakh alag. Mahine ka ghaata Rs1.5 lakh par stake Rs400; Rs2 lakh par normal plan. 1 Dec se apne aap normal plan. Desawar base Rs500 x Nov 1.5 = Rs750 (thanda din Rs375, garam din cap par Rs750). Gali Rs750 base: Sun/Fri Rs1,125, Tue/Wed Rs375, thanda Rs375, garam Rs1,125. Desawar 10 number 1 Dec se.

calendar.note: Stake multipliers (sirf jodi par; haruf flat). mult = weekday x month x cool-down, phir cap. Cool-down trigger = Desawar ka result us din ki V7 top-8 list mein tha (hamara hit): us raat Gali aur agli subah Desawar same_day_mult; agar us raat Gali (plan numbers) bhi hit -> agli subah Desawar SKIP. rebound_after_days game-day baad Gali/Desawar rebound_mult. Walk-forward 2015-2026: Gali +35.5% -> +42.7% ROI, Desawar +32% -> +38%.

cooldown.trigger: Desawar result in that day's V7 top-8

date_rule.note: Operator aaj ki tarikh wala number (jaise 22 tarikh ko 22) aur uska palti kam kholta hai: sab 6 market mein 0.50% / 0.66% (tukka 1%), 2013-2026. Plan ke numbers mein aisa number ho to hata do; uski jagah naya number nahi. Desawar ke liye tarikh = jis subah result aata hai. 'from' se pehle ke dino par lagu nahi (purana hisaab waisa hi rahe).
